title.narrative: Expansion of the HIV National Response in key and vulnerable populations in urban areas and Amazonian region of Peru - Peru (01-Jul-2019-30-Jun-2022)

description.narrative: Peru, HIV, CARE Peru (CARE Peru)This program has the following goals: Contribute to the reduction of new cases of HIV in key and vulnerable populations in Peru.. The objectives of this program are: Improve access to prevention, diagnosis, linkage and HIV care services for MT and MSM populations. Improve access to services for prevention, diagnosis, linkage and HIV care for the Amazonian indigenous population. Improve the Continuum of Care for PLWH (goal 90 90 90). Strengthen community response from key and vulnerable population
